interface.shortDescription: BDD spec-driven delivery workflow for GitHub issue work.
interface.longDescription: NMG SDLC provides a structured manual software delivery workflow: onboard a project, draft and start GitHub issues, write BDD requirements and implementation plans, implement from specs, verify against acceptance criteria, open pull requests, and address review comments.
defaultPrompt: Onboard this project for spec-driven delivery.
Draft a GitHub issue for this feature.
